description: Instrumentation testing code for Android TV app UI, focusing on browsing and video player functionalities.

classes.name: BrowseAndPlayerInstrumentedTest
classes.description: Instrumentation test class for verifying browsing and video playback UI interactions on Android TV.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes intents tracking and launches MainActivity for testing.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Releases intents tracking and closes activity scenario after tests.

methods.name: browse_rendersMainContainer_andFocusIsSet
methods.description: Verifies the main container view is displayed and focusable.

methods.name: browse_clicksFirstItem_andLaunchesPlayerActivity
methods.description: Simulates clicking on the main container and checks if PlayerActivity is launched.

methods.name: player_showsPlayerView_andHandlesDpadKeys
methods.description: Launches PlayerActivity directly, verifies the player view is displayed and focusable, then simulates key presses (DPad events).
